feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. The candidate is the iteration 6 design, resubmitted unchanged. Iteration 6 scored 937.10 with 60/60 finishes (oval 944.7, s-bend 940.9, slalom 925.7), and iteration 10 reproduced that score exactly, so the design is reproducible on the development tracks. Every single-variable neighbour tested scored lower: kd 0.9 at y=0.06 gave 865.3 (iteration 8), y=0.07 with kd 1.1 gave 930.9 (iteration 7), and kd 1.1 at y=0.06 gave 925.9 (iteration 9). Raising kp to 4.5 (iteration 2) and to 6.0 with a seven-sensor array (iteration 4) both lost oval and s-bend completions. Mass is at its 0.40 kg floor, and the 0.06 m off-track floor binds, so body_width cannot widen the limit. This is the final iteration, so a further revise round would cost two action runs and leave no iteration to test its result. The best evidence available is this design, so approval is correct. Its remaining loss is slalom line-loss events (about 0.65 per run) and a slalom mean finish near 2.92 s. The unseen track is not measured, so the margin on it is unknown.
requested_changes: Race the iteration 6 design unchanged: geometry sensor_positions at x = -0.03, -0.015, 0.0, 0.015, 0.03 with y = 0.06, sensor_size 0.016, mass 0.40, controller kp 4.0, ki 0.05, kd 1.0, base_speed 1.5, weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], line_loss last_direction. Basis: iterations 6 and 10 both measured 937.10 with 60/60 finishes.

Record per-track completion, max_error, line_loss_events, completion_time, steering_oscillation and noise_robustness, so the margin left on a different shape can be read. Basis: the unseen-track result is the only score left, and these measures show how much of the development margin survives.
